__vite_ssr_exportName__("reportUncaught", () => { try { return reportUncaught } catch {} });
function runAllCallbacks(callbacks) {
  let firstFailure;
  for (const callback of callbacks) {
    try {
      callback();
    } catch (error) {
      firstFailure ??= { error };
    }
  };
  if (firstFailure) throw firstFailure.error;
};
function reportUncaught(error) {
  queueMicrotask(() => {
    throw error;
  });
}
